```python
from hamana import Query
from hamana.core.column import IntegerColumn, StringColumn, DateColumn

query = Query(
    query="SELECT id, name, created_at FROM users",
    columns=[
        IntegerColumn(name="id"),
        StringColumn(name="name"),
        DateColumn(name="created_at")
    ]
)

print(f"Query: {query.query}")
print(f"Columns: {[col.name for col in query.columns]}")
for col in query.columns:
    print(f"  - {col.name}: {col.dtype.value}")
```
